title: Replace Digital Nomad Visa comparison chart image on Product Offerings page

requirements.text: In the Product Offerings page Digital Nomad Visa section, replace the current comparison chart image (currently referenced as `src="/assets/Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas.png"`) with the newly uploaded image asset, keeping the same layout (65% width container) and updating the `` `src` only if the final asset filename differs.

quotes: In the Product Offerings Page, Under Digital Nomad Visa, Replace the Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas by six criteria Image with the attached file

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to Product Offerings → Professionals → Digital Nomad Visa shows the new comparison chart image instead of the old one.
No other images in the Digital Nomad Visa section (Portugal/Spain/Malta/Hungary/Italy) are changed.
The comparison chart remains centered and constrained by the existing 65% width container without overflow on mobile or desktop.

requirements.text: Add the uploaded comparison chart image to the frontend static assets so it is served at the path used by the Digital Nomad comparison chart (under `frontend/public/assets/`).

quotes: Replace the Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas by six criteria Image with the attached file

acceptanceCriteria: The new image exists in the built frontend assets under `public/assets/` and loads successfully at runtime (no broken image icon / 404).

constraints: Do not edit any files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or any other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: No changes to backend canister logic (Motoko).
No content/text changes to the Digital Nomad Visa section beyond swapping the comparison chart image.

required: A table-style comparison chart titled "Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas" with country flags (Spain, Italy, Hungary, Portugal, Malta) and multiple criteria rows (Comparison of Digital Nomad Visas.dim_1536x1152.png)
